text: Dimitri Khundadze - Only peace is the necessary condition that will facilitate economic development; Georgia is moving in the right direction with its improvisational policy.
Only peace is the necessary condition that will promote economic development, – the General Secretary of "People's Power", Dimitri Khundadze, stated.
Speaking about Georgia's role as one of the important players in the Middle Corridor, Dimitri Khundadze noted that the country's economic development will maintain its function as a regional leader.
According to him, this can only be achieved under conditions of peace, as war and development are unimaginable together.

"Peace is an essential condition for utilizing the country's transport capabilities. A few days ago, when the situation in the Middle East became extremely tense, only Georgia's airspace was congested on the air transport map. This was a very small example in the big picture of what I am saying, that peace is an essential condition for the fulfillment of the transit function."

How is it possible for a country to join sanctions when you cannot achieve any results from it, even for the requester? How do you imagine the destruction of the Russian economy through Georgian sanctions? Our opponents raise the issue that active steps must be taken to improve social conditions, pensions and salaries must be increased, jobs must be created, tourism must be developed, and so on. They have presented their proposals in specific figures. For example, representatives of Gakharia's party introduced an initiative stating that the minimum wage should be 1,050 GEL. "Lelo" raises the issue of increasing the pension to 1,000 GEL, and all of this is supposed to happen against the backdrop of sanctions? In a state of war, this is surely unimaginable?!

These are hypocritically noble statements. Some occasionally let it slip that it is better for hot bombs to be falling than for there to be peace in Georgia. Development and war – these two things are incompatible. It is a fact that Georgia, with its improvisational policy, is heading in the right direction.

For comparison, in Ukraine today, no one thinks about increasing pensions, building schools and kindergartens. In Ukraine, there is only one concern: how this or that family member might somehow survive. More than 10 million people have already become displaced, the economy is destroyed.

In our country, the tourism indicator has increased over the past year. It was 4.4 billion in 2024, and 4.7 was recorded in 2025. Investments are growing, and the country's economy has increased to 100 billion. This is precisely where the opportunity lies for infrastructure to develop, for investments to flow in, and for even more tourists. Subsequently, it will be possible to increase pensions more rapidly and create jobs with greater intensity – in the recent period, they have increased by 40 thousand.

“I am not saying that everything is perfect; I am saying that in this extremely difficult period, through such a policy, we have not only maintained peace and avoided war, but we have managed to ensure that things are better in every direction than they were yesterday; however, this is not enough, and we want even better,” stated Dimitri Khundadze.
